decision.reason: W384 already projects 2.535x, while the unresolved token-to-delta, payload-memory latency, descriptor completion and commit semantics can erase the narrow 2.5x margin or make the standalone blocks non-composable. Further compression would optimize an interface whose executable meaning is not yet closed.

frozen_w384_projection.scope: same-clock precompacted H67 bottleneck service-island software projection

inside_m113_dut: one-cycle synchronous payload ROM/SRAM model initialized from frozen M41 weights and M72 PWP centers
PWP variable-width beat assembler and correction INT8 held-weight assembler
signed24 lane-delta mapper with correction negate
M112 lane-sliced accumulator adapter plus 96 behavioral 3072x24 synchronous 1R1W arrays
commit base/context tagger and padded-row accounting
cycle, token, update, descriptor and commit conservation counters
outside_m113_dut_but_frozen_in_test_evid: offline lossless precompaction from frozen M40 raw support
exact signed integer accumulator and commit oracle
always-ready performance commit sink plus separate adversarial-backpressure campaigns
explicitly_excluded: raw raster scan and hardware compactor
foundry SRAM macros and macro compiler rounding
minimum_integration_boundary.minimum_claim_if_passed: commercial-VCS integrated cycle evidence for a precompacted W384 service-island trace; not physical, equal-area, system, end-to-end or headline

descriptor_ingress.context_allocation_recommendation: context[15:14]=operator, context[13:5]=partition, context[4:0]=rolling epoch; base_row identifies W384 window and sample is an outer replay tag
descriptor_ingress.source_protocol: credit-qualified pulse-on-ready trace source or an explicit skid adapter; do not hold valid high into M110 unavailable-bank fail-fast quarantine

pwp_request_stream.payload_semantics: 96 signed lanes packed contiguously at width 8..11; unused final-beat bits zero; final response sign-extends all lanes to signed24 and issues exactly one accumulator seed update
pwp_request_stream.ordering: all PWP seeds for one descriptor retire before its first M110 correction event update

correction_service_bridge.load_semantics: each of three 256-bit beats supplies 32 signed INT8 lanes in lane order 0..31,32..63,64..95
correction_service_bridge.completion_extension: add or wrap a descriptor_done valid/ready event carrying base/context/sequence and empty flag; service_last_for_key is not descriptor completion and empty descriptors emit no service token

shared_payload_memory.commands: one 256-bit read request accepted per cycle across PWP and correction load traffic
shared_payload_memory.response: one-cycle synchronous response with stable valid/data under bridge backpressure
shared_payload_memory.required_bypass: the final load response must feed the following correction event update without an extra service bubble; PWP final response must update while the next payload request can issue
shared_payload_memory.arbitration: PWP owns the lane until the descriptor seed phase completes; M110 service_ready is then released for correction load/event service

accumulator_connection.address: M112 exact flattened macro address block*384+row in 0..3071
accumulator_connection.same_address_rule: prove zero consecutive accepted updates to the same block,row on the exact trace; any violation currently causes permanent reset-only quarantine
accumulator_connection.update_conservation: exactly 58969374 PWP updates plus 188148490 correction event updates for the full heldout trace

window_and_commit.start: one accumulator window_start before partition 0 PWP of each global W384 window
window_and_commit.end: issue window_end only after partition 431 descriptor_done and the final accepted update write pipeline retires
window_and_commit.next_window_overlap: M110 may fill at most its bounded banks during commit, but accumulator updates remain blocked until window_done and the next window_start
window_and_commit.commit_tag: attach outer sample/operator/base; global destination row is base+commit_row; all sidebands valid-qualified
window_and_commit.current_m112_behavior: always emits 8*384 vectors; consume/drop padded rows >=valid_rows but charge their cycles
window_and_commit.optional_exact_projection_extension: add valid_rows to the accumulator commit iterator to stop at 312 rows in the last window; otherwise revise candidate by the measured padding and interface-edge delta

known_cycle_reconciliation.window_start_end_and_commit_pipeline_edg: must be measured, not presumed absorbed by the existing 160 flush cycles
known_cycle_reconciliation.admission_rule: publish the observed integrated candidate and delta ledger; do not force the RTL total to equal 439708199

integrated_replay_first.critical_observation: only 6237180 extra cycles can be added before W384 falls below 2.5x

one_unhidden_payload_bubble_per_group.conclusion: would erase the 2.5x crossing; this is why integration has priority

event_or_group_skip.reason: no proven weight residency or numeric skip rule; correction events cannot be removed without changing results

findings.finding: M110 emits load/event identities and direction but no payload or lane delta; M112 requires an exact 2304-bit signed24 update. No PWP source, weight payload memory, beat assembler, sign extension, negate, or token-to-update conservation path exists.
findings.required_action: Implement and VCS-miter the shared payload arbiter plus PWP/correction assemblers and signed24 delta mapper defined in the recommended interface.

findings.finding: M110 has no descriptor completion sideband, empty descriptors emit no service token, and M112 has no base/context or valid-row-count contract. Therefore partition-431 completion, window_end timing and final 312-row commit cannot be composed from current public interfaces.
findings.required_action: Expose ordered descriptor_done including empty/base/context and freeze accumulator start/end/valid_rows or explicitly charge padded commit cycles.

findings.finding: The W384 projection has only 6237180 cycles of 2.5x margin. One unhidden synchronous payload-read bubble per 8271296 active groups would lower the ratio to 2.488648x.
findings.required_action: Commercial VCS must demonstrate the final-response bypass and zero extra load-to-event bubble, or publish the measured lower ratio.

findings.finding: M109 starts from losslessly precompacted correction events and PWP assignments. Dense/raw scanning, assignment, queue storage and delivery bandwidth are not charged.
findings.required_action: Keep M113 strictly labeled precompacted service island and freeze the trace-generation boundary; do not describe it as end-to-end module performance.

findings.finding: Existing results freeze aggregate W384 work but not an executable per-descriptor PWP/event/payload/address trace and digest.
findings.required_action: Generate exact-SHA binary trace and compact per-record receipts before RTL replay.

findings.finding: M112 permanently quarantines a consecutive same-address update. Structural spacing appears likely, but all 247117864 actual update addresses have not been replayed.
findings.required_action: Audit the full update-address sequence offline and assert zero consecutive matches in integrated VCS.

findings.finding: Presenting valid while no fill bank is available is a sticky protocol fault. A conventional producer holding valid across ready-low is not directly composable.
findings.required_action: Use a credit-qualified trace source or add a skid/credit adapter and include its cycles and capacity.

findings.finding: M112 maps to 96 behavioral 3072x24 1R1W arrays. Foundry-supported depth/width, RDW mode, latency, ECC, area, timing and energy remain open.
findings.required_action: Treat M113 only as commercial functional/cycle evidence; macro closure is a later milestone.

findings.finding: A small integrated trace closes the transition kernel but cannot by itself turn the full 439708199-cycle result into an RTL-measured ratio.
findings.required_action: Either run all 20 records in VCS or formally prove that the full software trace replay is equivalent to the VCS-validated transition kernel; preserve tiered admission.

findings.finding: M109 quotes 909352 bytes before valid tags, while M111/M112 add 3072 valid bits. The minimum logical subtotal is at least 909736 bytes before controller, ECC and macro rounding.
findings.suggested_action: Carry both the 884736-byte data array and at-least-909736-byte combined logical subtotal.

findings.finding: Operator/partition allocation inside context, base alignment and final valid-row count are not frozen by M110.
findings.suggested_action: Adopt the recommended context map and assert base in {0,384,...,2688} with valid_rows=min(384,3000-base).

findings.finding: M111/M112 retain commit fields when commit_valid is low; the integration tagger and scoreboard must not interpret idle sidebands.
findings.suggested_action: Qualify all commit base/context/block/row/data/last checks with commit_valid.
